evidence.text: The function `getCirculatingSupplyAndAssets` is used during share-to-asset and asset-to-share conversions. It relies on `totalInvestmentAssets`, which includes `rBalance` from the investment share token. However, `rBalance` is not stable and can be reversed via `WERC7575ShareToken::cancelrBalanceAdjustment`. If `rBalance` is later corrected, users whose deposits or redemptions were executed based on the incorrect value will receive inaccurate share amounts or asset amounts, effectively causing value shifts between users.
Because deposits and redemptions use this value at execution time, any later correction to `rBalance` introduces inconsistency and unintended wealth transfer between users.
`_calculateInvestmentAssets` adds both the investment share token balance and its `rBalance`:

Do not include `rBalance` in investment asset calculations, as these balances are not realized. Only add them once they are fully realized and reflected in the actual vault asset balance. This prevents reversible or incorrect `rBalance` adjustments from corrupting share conversion logic.

links.reported_relation: Because conversions include rBalance and rBalance can later be corrected, deposits/redemptions executed on the incorrect value yield inaccurate share or asset amounts.
Including unrealized rBalance in investment asset calculations is what lets reversible/incorrect rBalance adjustments corrupt share conversion logic.
